rows.note: net-aware `clearance` always; the net-agnostic fab-view pass (`physical_copper_gap`, #8843) adds same-net copper but runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb` -- a `jlcpcb-tier*` profile gets `clearance` alone. Observed 2 danger (0.08 mm).

as `trace_spacing`, plus the 2 oz pad mask-bridge check inside `physical_copper_gap`; that check judges a declared 2 oz outer weight only and otherwise reports `physical_copper_gap_incomplete` at info. Observed 8 danger.

`mask_to_copper` is default-on for an explicit --mfr `jlcpcb*` since #8842 (interim 0.09 mm danger / 0.15 mm warning); a bare `kct check` with no --mfr does not engage it, and the native path needs an unmodified saved source. Observed 5 danger.

`tht_smd_spacing` (#8843) judges plated through-hole *component* pads only: vias are excluded by default and same-footprint pad pairs are skipped, while JLCDFM flags through-hole pads and vias. Fab-view gated -- runs only when the effective --mfr is exactly `jlcpcb`. Observed 5 danger.

no rule: no copper-weight-aware annular-ring floor exists yet. Observed 100 warnings.

`mask_negative_expansion` (#8847) warns on every opening whose effective margin is < 0 mm; default-on pure geometry read from the saved source, so an unsaved or edited board reports coverage unknown rather than a pass. The recorded 4 warnings were not re-measured.

`mask_multi_segment` (#8847) warns on every opening whose geometry is more than one disjoint piece; same default-on saved-source snapshot as `mask_negative_expansion`. The recorded 21 warnings were not re-measured.

`sharp_trace_corner` (#8840) reports all 3 observed vertices (pinned in its tests). It is stricter than JLCDFM was observed to be: it also reports branch junctions with an open wedge, which JLCDFM did not flag on that board.
`missing_plated_hole` (#8840) flags same-net top/bottom SMD pads whose centres coincide (0.05 mm); overlapping pads with offset centres are not checked. The observed 2 warnings were not re-measured.
